ploidyspec report: daLatClan1

Summary

Structure in this individual's assembly, read from the sections below; not inheritance and not origin. See docs/guide, Chapter 6.

Ploidy

2 haplotype copies of each of 21 chromosome numbers; the numbers form sets of 2 (9 groups of mostly 2 chromosome numbers), so x ≈ 9 and up to 4x relative to x; the sets are nearly as diverged as unrelated chromosomes, so they may be an old (paleo) duplication.

Confidence: medium. Evidence: copies from the assembly (2 per number); 9 groups of mostly 2 chromosome numbers (genome partition z = 10.6); homeolog distance 0.093 vs unrelated 0.108

Auto-like or allo-like?

Auto-like origin, mostly rediploidized: the duplicated sets have separated along most of their length, but 2 of 21 paired chromosome numbers keep stretches where the homeologs are as close as alleles (residual tetrasomy). That is expected after an autopolyploidization; recent homeologous exchanges in an allopolyploid can leave similar stretches.

Confidence: medium. Evidence: 18 chromosome numbers assessed: 18 split into lineages, 0 tetrasomic-like, 0 one divergent copy, 0 candidate; residual tetrasomy on 2/21 homeolog-paired chromosome numbers, 14.5 Mb, 0% of it terminal

TE markers

Only the absolute marker fraction is available (two copies per number); it does not separate diploid, auto- and allopolyploid, so no reading is made from it.

Confidence: not assessable. Evidence: te_marker_fraction mean 0.2535

Rediploidization

Partly: 2 of 21 homeolog-paired chromosome numbers keep stretches of residual tetrasomy (14.5 Mb, 0% of it at chromosome ends) where the homeologs are still as close as alleles; elsewhere they have diverged. Also: 12 chromosome(s) carry blocks homeologous to two or more others (chr02:chr11+chr19, chr03:chr04+chr10, chr04:chr03+chr13, chr05:chr07+chr17+chr18, chr06:chr07+chr16, chr07:chr05+chr06+chr14, chr11:chr01+chr02, chr12:chr14+chr21, chr14:chr07+chr12+chr20, chr16:chr06+chr09, chr18:chr05+chr15, chr20:chr08+chr14): fusions, fissions or translocations since the duplication; homeolog blocks diverged to different depths (CV 0.60), as when regions resolve at different times; homeologous-exchange candidates on 1 chromosome(s), stretches closer to the homeolog than to the own homolog (exchange, or a contig placed on the wrong chromosome).

Confidence: medium. Evidence: residual tetrasomy on 2/21 homeolog-paired chromosome numbers, 14.5 Mb, 0% of it terminal; pair-depth CV 0.04; homeology map: 28% of the genome in 55 homeolog blocks, 18 chromosome pairs, block-divergence CV 0.60; exchange: chr07(chr05:1/2;chr14:1/2)

Copy number and copy divergence (whole-chromosome matrix)

Hierarchically reordered, chromosome-number resolution

Same distance data as the heatmaps above, but collapsed to one value per chromosome NUMBER (haplotype copies aggregated away) and reordered by average-linkage clustering -- shows cross-chromosome (subgenome/ancestral-pair) structure cleanly, including diffuse structure with no individually FDR-significant pair. Red outlines mark individually FDR-accepted pairs from the homeolog test below. See INTERPRETATION.md's "checkerboard" section.
